name: Exp_Digital_CCI_Woodies
summary: This EA trades based on the Digital CCI Woodies indicator, which uses two smoothed CCI lines to generate buy and sell signals via crossover logic. It opens and closes positions on new bar events when the two indicator buffer lines cross, with configurable money management, stop loss, and take profit. The strategy is a momentum-based system applying multiple smoothing methods to CCI data.
summary_zh: 该EA基于Digital CCI Woodies指标进行交易，通过两条平滑CCI线的交叉逻辑生成买卖信号。在新K线出现时，当两条指标缓冲线发生交叉时开仓和平仓，支持可配置的资金管理、止损和止盈。该策略是一个基于动量的系统，对CCI数据应用多种平滑方法。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念基于Digital CCI Woodies指标的两条线交叉来捕捉动量变化方向。入场条件为：当UpValue线从下方穿越DnValue线时开多单，当UpValue线从上方穿越DnValue线时开空单，交叉确认需要两根K线的比较。出场条件为：当反向交叉发生时平仓，例如持有多单时UpValue线跌破DnValue线则平多单，同时也可通过固定的StopLoss和TakeProfit参数来控制出场。仓位管理采用TradeAlgorithms.mqh中的MarginMode枚举，支持按余额百分比、可用保证金百分比或固定手数等多种模式。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，MMMode决定具体的仓位计算方式，默认使用固定手数模式(LOT)。策略仅在新K线形成时检测信号（IsNewBar机制），避免了同一根K线内重复交易的问题。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the crossover of two lines from the Digital CCI Woodies indicator to capture momentum direction changes. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when the UpValue line crosses above the DnValue line, and a sell signal is generated when the UpValue line crosses below the DnValue line, with crossover confirmation requiring comparison across two consecutive bars. Exit conditions: positions are closed on reverse crossovers — for example, a long position is closed when UpValue drops below DnValue, and stop loss/take profit levels provide additional exit control. Position sizing uses the MarginMode enum from TradeAlgorithms.mqh, supporting percentage of balance, percentage of free margin, or fixed lot size modes. Money management is controlled via the MM parameter for risk ratio, with MMMode determining the specific lot calculation method, defaulting to fixed lot size (LOT). The strategy only checks signals on new bar formation (IsNewBar mechanism), preventing repeated trades within the same bar.

pros: 使用双平滑CCI交叉系统，有效过滤市场噪音，信号更可靠
支持多种平滑算法（SMA/EMA/JJMA/JurX/T3/VIDYA/AMA等），灵活度高
新K线机制避免重复交易，减少过度交易风险
止损止盈参数齐全，风险控制框架完整
买卖方向开关独立，可以只做单边交易
pros_en: Dual smoothed CCI crossover system effectively filters market noise for more reliable signals
Supports multiple smoothing algorithms (SMA/EMA/JJMA/JurX/T3/VIDYA/AMA) providing high flexibility
New bar mechanism prevents repeated trades and reduces overtrading risk
Complete stop loss and take profit parameters provide a solid risk control framework
Independent buy/sell direction switches allow single-direction trading only
cons: 依赖自定义指标Digital_CCI_Woodies，如果指标文件缺失则EA无法运行
没有点差过滤，在高点差环境下可能出现不利成交
止损1000点和止盈2000点默认值过大，对多数品种可能不合理
缺少持仓检查逻辑，可能在已有同向仓位时重复开仓
没有时间过滤，在低流动性时段可能产生虚假信号
cons_en: Depends on the custom indicator Digital_CCI_Woodies; EA fails if the indicator file is missing
No spread filter, which may result in unfavorable fills in high-spread environments
Default stop loss of 1000 and take profit of 2000 points are excessively large for most instruments
Lacks position check logic, potentially opening duplicate positions in the same direction
No time filter, which may generate false signals during low-liquidity sessions
improvements: 增加点差过滤和时间过滤，避免不利交易环境下的开仓
增加持仓方向检查，避免同方向重复开仓导致仓位过重
improvements_en: Add spread filter and time filter to avoid opening positions in unfavorable trading conditions
Add position direction check to prevent duplicate openings in the same direction that over-concentrate risk

risk_points: 缺少点差过滤，高点差环境可能导致不利成交
没有同向持仓检查，可能重复开仓放大风险
依赖外部自定义指标文件，存在运行时缺失风险
risk_points_en: No spread filter; high-spread environments may cause unfavorable executions
No same-direction position check; may duplicate positions and amplify risk
Depends on external custom indicator file with runtime missing-file risk
